construct: Pregnancy increases circulating thyroxine-binding globulin, largely through estrogen effects. The initial fall in free thyroid hormone stimulates increased thyroid hormone production until a new equilibrium is reached with normal free T4 and TSH but increased total T4 because more hormone is protein bound.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Normal free T4 and TSH with elevated total T4 in pregnancy is the classic steady-state consequence of estrogen-associated increased thyroxine-binding globulin.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Autonomous thyroid hormone production could raise total T4, but it would tend to raise free hormone and suppress TSH rather than preserve the euthyroid pattern.
adversarial_second_pass.expert_reviewer_reversal: A binding-protein change uniquely explains high total hormone with normal free hormone and intact TSH feedback.
